rationale: Held text (41 FR 26849) confirms EO 11925's sole clause, which amends EO 11554 as amended by substituting September 30, 1978 for June 30, 1976. Held EO 12082 section 1-103 (signed 1978-09-19) revokes EO 11554 as amended, with no delay or savings clause, so the 11925 change ended 1978-09-19 by revocation of its parent; its substituted date would also have expired it by 1978-09-30. The number search found no earlier ending, the 1989 snapshot is only corroboration, and the gaps are honest, including that 12082 does not name 11925. The genuine decision is identical to the planted copy except for its status, and its NO is consistent with its rationale.
